description: Questions asked after earlier ones in the same conversation (2026-10-12), written before changing how the search query uses history (src/tools/history.py build_rag_search_query). kind=switch: a new topic, the earlier questions must not change the search (gold = the question alone). kind=follow: the question leans on an earlier one (그럼, 그거, 계속…); gold is the standalone question a person would write. Found on the deployed app: '심장사상충 약 얼마나 자주 먹여야 돼요?' answered 'not in the material' after two fee/place questions, and answered fine in a new conversation.
